title: Cup of hot cocoa
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- saucer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='34' ry='8' fill='#d9a066'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#f0c88a'/>
  <!-- cup body -->
  <path d='M26 40 L30 76 Q30 82 36 82 L64 82 Q70 82 70 76 L74 40 Z' fill='#e85a5a'/>
  <!-- cup rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='24' ry='7' fill='#f27c7c'/>
  <!-- cup inner shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='19' ry='5' fill='#a83a3a'/>
  <!-- cocoa surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='18' ry='4.5' fill='#6b3a1f'/>
  <!-- cocoa lighter swirl -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40.5' rx='11' ry='2.5' fill='#8a4f2a'/>
  <!-- marshmallows -->
  <rect x='38' y='37' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#fff6e8'/>
  <rect x='50' y='35.5' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#fff6e8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='39.5' width='7' height='5.5' rx='2' fill='#ffeadb'/>
  <!-- marshmallow shading -->
  <rect x='38' y='37' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='50' y='35.5' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M74 48 Q90 48 90 60 Q90 72 72 72' fill='none' stroke='#e85a5a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handle lighter edge -->
  <path d='M74 48 Q90 48 90 60 Q90 72 72 72' fill='none' stroke='#f27c7c' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- steam -->
  <path d='M40 30 Q36 24 40 18 Q44 12 40 6' fill='none' stroke='#a8d8ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 28 Q46 22 50 16 Q54 10 50 4' fill='none' stroke='#c0e4ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 30 Q56 24 60 18 Q64 12 60 6' fill='none' stroke='#a8d8ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
